description: GT unit auxiliary transformer 21/10.5 kV 31.5 MVA
remarks: Plant aux load SRC-NG-100 10.30 MW (AL-01..22 excl. GSU losses AL-08/09), LDO case about 10.9 MW, MAX case 9.70 MW; design MV bus load 11.1 MW incl. AL-21 losses = 12.6 MVA at pf 0.88, +10 % = 13.9 MVA (765 A at 10.5 kV). Each UAT must carry 100 %: 31.5 MVA also carries the GT static starter (SFC, about 9 MW, not in aux_load). uk 12 % gives 14.4 kA at 10.5 kV.
service: GT unit auxiliary transformer 21/10.5 kV (GT generator terminals to MV section A)
